description: Surgical edits turning the pristine Theater 1.10.0 settings.chunk.js into the VIDAA build. Re-anchored from the 1.9.2 baseline (8775223) onto the 1.10.0 minified output.

ops.note: Vidaa TV section: thin seam calling window.__vidaaSettingsRows(g, p) (settings/settings-ui.js) — g is the app's animations model (same identifier as 1.9.2), p the platform info. The UI itself lives in patch JS.
EDIT_URL dialog: plain local field + Auto-Detect button (settings/server-url-manager.js) + commit once on Confirm with reachability ping (VIDAA 0.0.0.x mask fix).
SERVER row: accept the page-level health probe (kernel/server-url.js __SERVER_HEALTH__) as online evidence, fixing false Offline when the core one-shot check failed.
